versions.changelog:
Initial release of pontx-dropbox-sign.

- Integrates Dropbox Sign eSignature workflows through Pontx, covering signature requests, templates, embedded signing, callbacks, test mode, document downloads, and HelloSign migrations.
- Provides detailed guidance for safe and compliant use, including workflow resolution, credential management, and mutation approval.
- Emphasizes best practices for authentication, test vs. production operation, callback verification, document handling, and retention.
- Includes practical usage scenarios for common signing workflows and integration patterns.
